content.title: SEC Punts Controversial Short-Sale Disclosure Deadline Again
content.summary: Investment managers will now have until Jan. 2, 2028 to comply with the short-sale rules and until Sept. 28, 2028 on the related stock lending disclosures, the SEC said in an order Wednesday.  The SEC issued the rules in October 2023, requiring certain investment managers to report short-sale data on a monthly basis.
